title: chore: add collective memory App secrets to computer MCP
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds sops-encrypted `GITHUB_APP_ID` + `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` in `apps/computer-mcp/secrets.vars.json` (App `pollinations-collective-memory`, id 4969517, Contents read/write, installed on `pollinations/collective-memory` only)
- `deploy.json` → `"sops": "default"`; `deploy` / `deploy:staging` pass the file via `sops exec-file … --secrets-file`, same as composio-mcp
- Same age recipients as composio-mcp (includes the CI key)
- Dedicated secrets PR for #15026, which uses them. Merge #15026 first, then this, then promote

Verify after production deploy: push a note to collective-memory through `gen.pollinations.ai/mcp/computer`.
Rollback: revert; delete the App private key in the App settings.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Memory gets its key
gist.blurb: The computer MCP now carries the sealed credentials it needs to tend the collective-memory garden. The keys stay encrypted; the notes can keep growing.
gist.summary: Added SOPS-encrypted GitHub App credentials and deploy-time secret injection for computer-mcp so it can write to the pollinations/collective-memory repository through the dedicated pollinations-collective-memory App.
gist.impact: After deployment, computer MCP can securely push collective-memory notes through gen.pollinations.ai/mcp/computer while the private key remains managed as encrypted deployment secret material.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden archivist using a tiny key to unlock a sealed, glowing memory journal beside a cozy CRT terminal. Code-plants and labeled note sprouts represent the collective-memory repository; the key should feel protected rather than exposed.
